name: lightbox
description: Shows the images you paste and the ones Claude reads, receives or creates in a small strip above the prompt: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, HEIC, AVIF, TIFF, BMP and SVG.

autoOpen.title: Show new images
autoOpen.description: Show the strip above the prompt again when a new image arrives, after you hid it. Off, a toast says one arrived.

renderer.title: How pictures are drawn
renderer.description: auto: real pixels where Claude Code draws them, colored character cells elsewhere (herdr, tmux, SSH). cells: always cells. pixels: always pixels, which show as the image's name where Claude Code does not draw pictures.

cellAspect.title: Cell height to width
cellAspect.description: How many times taller than wide one terminal cell is, so pictures keep their proportions. About 2.1 for most fonts; more with taller lines, such as Ghostty's adjust-cell-height.
